The '''Captain''' (Japanese: '''船長''' ''captain'') was a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP095|A Shipful of Shivers]]''.

He is a former winner of the [[Orange League]] who won the event using his {{p|Gastly}} and {{p|Haunter}} over 300 years ago. He used to sail a [[ghost ship|delivery ship]], going from island to island and delivering things to other islands. One night, 300 years ago, the ship was caught in a terrible storm and sunk.
